title: Beauty Specialist / Nail Technician
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Ensuring a welcoming and positive experience for all clients
description_text:
Our client is looking for a skilled and customer-focused Beauty Specialist / Nail Technician to join their team. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Providing professional manicure and pedicure services.
 Performing gel polish, gel extensions, acrylics, and nail infills.
 Creating nail art and customised nail designs.
 Providing other beauty treatments as required.
 Consulting with clients to understand their preferences and recommend suitable treatments.
 Maintaining high standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and professionalism.
 Ensuring a welcoming and positive experience for all clients.
 Requirements: 
 Previous experience as a Nail Technician or Beauty Specialist.
 Strong knowledge of manicure, pedicure, and nail enhancement techniques.
 Nail art experience is an advantage.
 Additional beauty treatment skills are considered an asset.
 Excellent customer service and communication skills.
 Creative, professional, and detail-oriented.
 Good command of English.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 What is offered: 
 Attractive salary package.
 Friendly and professional working environment.
 Opportunities for professional development.
 Full-time position.
 ✨ If you are passionate about beauty, love creating beautiful nails, and enjoy making clients feel their best, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and take the next step in your beauty career.
